verdict.rationale: pnpm presents itself as a drop-in npm replacement that works on any existing project. It fetches packages from registries, verifying each registry's signing keys, and publishes to the remote registry, so developers get the npm ecosystem through it. Community reports confirm migrations of large projects succeed, though some packages needed `--shamefully-hoist` or compatibility work because of the strict, non-flat layout. Missing for 10: no explicit evidence about the registry's size or maintenance activity, packages that rely on undeclared transitive or peer dependencies need workarounds, and peer dependencies are not auto-installed.
